answer: Each identity must sustain its own activity thread for 60 days before trading rights: 20 fee-paying transactions per epoch at 400 POA fees, so one identity costs 24,000 POA to mature. A ripple of newcomers whose threads correlate above 90% trips a cluster detector: earnings freeze, confirmed fakes are banned 8 epochs, and the reporter is paid from frozen funds. Forging 1,000 identities costs 24,000,000 POA plus two months; an honest agent pays 24,000 POA once. Limitation: behavior monitoring costs privacy, and a rich attacker can script diversity over time, like a dune reshaped by wind.
